end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Correctly gave human and plant examples across levels in 2 attempts.
Explained that tissues form organs and organs work together in organ systems.
Needed repeated practice ordering all five levels; final sequence was correct.
Discussed Amoeba as a one-celled organism performing life processes within one cell.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the difference between tissues, organs, and organ systems using examples such as muscle tissue, the heart, and the digestive system. Yash initially mixed up the heart with the circulatory system, but corrected this later by identifying the heart as an organ and explaining how it works with blood vessels to form the system. At home, ask Yash to make a five-step arrow diagram from cell to organism and add one example at each step.
